title: Secret Agent: Codeword~Sleep Induction (Snippet #1)
description: This is a very quick induction, with no wakener, and a simple trigger phrase to drop you into trance. I was playing around a bit in Audacity, not sure what direction I was going at the time, but I was really happy with this start and wanted to share with you all a bit of a behind the scenes tease. While short snippets like these are fun, (and produce great sounds), they can take me a long time to create when I'm playing with so much layering and special effects. So being able to get immediate feedback from people is an insane motivator for me to turn them into something greater. And I feel like this could be fun as a loop on its own, or maybe in an audio where you are kidnapped and reprogramed...
author: Mistress Shibby
